title.full: Appealing for the Merdeka Generation Package

summary.text: You can appeal if you meet the age and citizenship conditions and have good claims to be counted among the MG.

steps.name: Send your appeal
steps.text: If you meet the conditions, send your appeal by email, phone or mail. The Appeals Panel will not consider appeals if you miss the age criterion.

items: You must have been aged 60 or above in 2019, born on or earlier than 1959, and become a Singapore citizen after 31 December 1996. You must also have good claims to be counted among the MG.
Email contactus@merdeka.gov.sg, call 1800 2222 888, or mail Robinson Road P.O. Box 3060 Singapore 905060.

about.text: The Appeals Panel will not consider your appeal if you were born after 31 December 1959.

quotes.text: Citizens aged 60 years and above in 2019 (i.e. born on or earlier than 1959) who became Singapore citizens after 31 December 1996, but have good claims to be counted among the MG, can appeal for the MGP.
You can send your appeals to contactus@merdeka.gov.sg or call 1800 2222 888. You can also mail to Robinson Road P.O. Box 3060 Singapore 905060.
Similar to the Pioneer Generation Package, the Appeals Panel will not consider appeals from those who miss out on the age criterion (i.e. born after 31 December 1959 in this case).
